name: HGRN-2 Gated DeltaNet Hybrid Attention Module — Production-Hardened (v2).
description: HGRN-2 Gated DeltaNet Hybrid Attention Module — Production-Hardened (v2).  Combines bidirectional/causal HGRN-2 element-wise linear recurrence with multi-head Gated DeltaNet associative matrix memory.  Fixes (v2):   HGD-FIX-01  is_custom_attention = True (this IS attention).   HGD-FIX-02  Balanced gate init (+/-log(0.9/0.1) instead of 4.0).   HGD-FIX-03  Idempotency guard in injector.   HGD-FIX-04
math_latex:
\begin{aligned}
Y_{\text{hgrn}} &= \text{HGRN2}(X) \\
Y_{\text{deltanet}} &= \text{GatedDeltaNet}(X) \\
\gamma &= \sigma(W_g X) \\
Y &= \gamma \odot Y_{\text{hgrn}} + (1 - \gamma) \odot Y_{\text{deltanet}} \\
\text{Output} &= Y W_o
\end{aligned}

components.name: Factor U (Full-Rank Expansion Projection)
components.math_latex: y_t = z_t (\Sigma_r U_r^\top) + b, \quad U_r \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}

components.name: Residual LoRA / Norm Calibration
components.math_latex: \Delta y_t = x_t (B A)^\top \cdot \frac{\alpha}{r}, \quad A \in \mathbb{R}^{r \times d_{in}}, \; B \in \mathbb{R}^{d_{out} \times r}
